newsitem.title: UK: European cotton markets see limited, patchy trade.
newsitem.headline: European cotton markets see limited, patchy trade.

text.p: European raw cotton markets saw patchy mill buying as spinners sought to cover outstanding requirements for January and February, industry sources said.
Firmer New York futures prices boosted the resolve of sellers holding back from the market in expectation of supply shortages in the New Year, they said.
Prices for U.S.and Australian cottons were quoted up 0.25 cents a lb but other origins were quoted unchanged.
